_meta.status: PROVISIONAL match rules and faction fixtures for the G0+G1 slice.
_meta.rebalance_2026_10_23: Credits were the only binding constraint (stipend-only income; G-ai probe found materials piling up 3000+ and 30-min sieges). Shifted unit/building costs toward gathered salvage/ore and raised the stipend 3->6 cr/s so gathering drives the economy. Still PROVISIONAL fixtures.
_meta.first_attack_tick: Earliest tick an AI may launch an offensive (20 ticks/s): easy 10 min, normal 7 min, hard 5 min. PROVISIONAL. Added 2026-10-23 after the UI playtest showed a 3-minute HQ kill on a new player.
_meta.g2: G2 tactical fixtures (armor_facing, cover, components, suppression, morale, concealment, supply, refinery, repair, ops). PROVISIONAL, untuned.
_meta.wreck_salvage: Destroyed vehicles/buildings drop a harvestable salvage pile (fraction of their salvage cost; HQ fixed). Added 2026-10-23: G2 soak seed 4 stalled when every map pile was exhausted. Spec basis: 'disabled vehicles may remain salvageable'. PROVISIONAL.
